summary_ja: 適格STC証券化エクスポージャーのリスク・ウェイトの算出は、適用日から一年間はなお従前の例によることができる。
summary_en: The risk weight of qualifying STC securitization exposures may be calculated under the old rules for one year from the application date.
paragraphs: With respect to the calculation of the risk weight of qualifying STC securitization exposures prescribed in Article 245-2, paragraph (3) of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of Assets, etc. Held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc, before its amendment by this Public Notice, for the period until the day on which one year has elapsed from the date of application of this Public Notice (referred to as the "Application Date" in paragraph (2) of the following Article), the provisions then in force may continue to be followed, notwithstanding Chapter 5, Section 2, Subsection 2, Division 7 of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of Assets, etc. Held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc, after its amendment by this Public Notice (referred to as the "New Public Notice" in the following Article).
